title: Releases page: each release folds to one line
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "the releases should be collapsed." On System Configuration → Releases each release is now one line (#N · title, where it stands, when); click it for the full card as before. Open by default only while it needs you (planned, plan approved, on staging, vetted, scheduled); live, turned off, rolled back and withdrawn stay folded. A link to a release (#rel-N, from Pulse or the staging bar) opens it and goes to it. What you open or close is remembered per release until its state changes. Staff only; nothing else on the page changes.
